items.text: – Hmm, yifake efrizeni. Uma uyifaka efrizeni, akukho okuzoyehlela, noma ngabe unyaka wonke. Nanoma yini enye esele, nayo yifake efrizeni.
items.q: A mother mentions the freezer. Is 'efrizeni' the everyday word for a home freezer, correctly spelled and inflected here?
before: – Yebo, ngizidlile, Nini-jan. Ungakhathazeki. Kusele kancane nje kwe-lavashak yezithelo uMahboub ayenza ekhaya.
